'''Berana Shemon''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]]. She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]] and was elected [[Sitter]] in the [[Rebel Hall of the Tower]], despite being [[Too Young Sitters|too young]]. She has no Warder.

== Appearance and Personality ==
She is 5'4 1/2 tall, haughty, with big brown eyes cold as snow and dark brown hair. She looks slim compared to [[Aledrin]] and has silver-embroidered white skirts. {{ref/book|10|19}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Berana is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|weak]] in the [[One Power]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of {{opsl|34}}. This is too weak to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

She is described as a fast learner.

==History==
Berana is seventy years old, she was born in the year {{ne|930}} and went to the Tower in {{ne|947}}. After spending ten years as Novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|965}}.

==Activities==
As a sitter, she votes "yes" on the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] declaring war on [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]{{ref/book|8|19}}, and later, for an alliance with the [[Black Tower]]{{ref/book|10|20}}.

She is one of the Sitters to re-swear the [[Three Oaths]] on the [[Oath Rod]] and prove that she is not [[Black Ajah]]. She agrees with Egwene's plans to seize every Aes Sedai and make them re-swear the oaths{{ref/book|12|43}}. She is then part of the unanimous vote to attack the [[White Tower]] with their army.

She steps down as Sitter after the Tower is re-unified{{ref/book|13|27}}.
